summary: Valneva SE filed a Form 6-K on October 8, 2026, attaching an October 7, 2026 press release disclosing that the UK MHRA revoked the marketing authorization for its chikungunya vaccine IXCHIQ following a Commission on Human Medicines benefit-risk reassessment for travelers, unrelated to any new safety signal. Valneva will not appeal, citing immaterial financial and commercial impact, low UK traveler sales, and no remaining UK product; EU, Canada, and Brazil licenses remain intact. This is a routine regulatory/product update, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor are stated. Risk-arb angle: none, though watch for any follow-on safety reviews or partner actions.
